notes.title: Last Autofire related update!
notes.content:
I've fixed a bug related to the autofire, which was a 10-second "waittime" for the player after the laser powerup ended. In that time it was not possible to toggle autofire nor picking up the laser powerup again.
Also I've toggled autofire at the start of a game ON, because many people don't seem to know that there's an autofire mode^^

notes.title: Small Update!
notes.content:
Small changes;
*False text-font for some systems should be fixed
*Rate of autofire increased from .3 to .2 sek on normal mode, and from .2 to .18   sec on hard mode
*Rare occurrences of buggy autofire should be fixed

Have a nice day!
